bands_required.description: Specific spectral or SAR bands required by downstream dataloader (e.g. ['VV', 'VH'] or ['B04', 'B08']).
bands_required.title: Bands Required

cloud_penetration_needed.description: Whether SAR is required due to cloud occlusion or night conditions.
cloud_penetration_needed.title: Cloud Penetration Needed

temporal_comparison.description: True if query compares two points in time (bi-temporal change).
temporal_comparison.title: Temporal Comparison

grounding_target.description: Target feature to localize for grounding_rs_specialist (e.g. 'water', 'built_up', 'vegetation').
grounding_target.title: Grounding Target

grounding_prompt.description: Text prompt if task involves locating/bounding specific regions.
grounding_prompt.title: Grounding Prompt

vqa_question.description: Precise visual question to be answered by the specialist VQA model.
vqa_question.title: Vqa Question

description:
Root task specification output by Member 2's Router.

task_type.description: The primary remote-sensing task identified from the natural language query.

sensors.description: Sensors expected or recommended for the task.
sensors.title: Sensors

primary_tool.description: The primary specialist model or GIS tool from the registry to execute.

secondary_tools.description: Optional auxiliary tools (e.g., indices calculator or cloud mask).
secondary_tools.title: Secondary Tools

evidence_requested.description: Visual and numerical evidence to extract (e.g. ['change_mask', 'confidence_score', 'area_km2']).
evidence_requested.title: Evidence Requested

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence score required for definitive assertions.
confidence_threshold.title: Confidence Threshold

audit_summary.description: Auditable human-readable execution summary (task, selected tool, reasoning).
audit_summary.title: Audit Summary
